integrity: A standalone reproducibility script verifies finite cases; its finite computations do not certify the infinite-field theorem.
scientific_limitations: The general result uses Hasse’s bound for smooth genus-one curves. The finite exceptional-field classification was checked by exhaustive standalone arithmetic. Historical priority is bounded by the literature inspected; independently audited novelty is not asserted. No even-characteristic claim is made.
title: Elliptic three-step convolution and exact diameter exceptions for inverse-graph Cayley walks
